results.title: 33k-Mile 2009 Bentley Azure
results.description: This 2009 Bentley Azure was first delivered to Bentley Paramus in New Jersey with almost $25k in options, including 19" six twin-spoke alloy wheels, stainless-steel matrix mesh grilles, an Alpine sound system, and a wood and leather steering wheel. Finished in Beluga with a black soft top over Cotswold leather, it is powered by a twin-turbocharged 6.75-liter V8 linked with a six-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes a Flying B hood ornament, an electronically controlled adaptive suspension, Park Distance Control, and heated front seats with lumbar support and position memory. The car was acquired by the seller's father in 2023, and it now has 33k miles. This Azure is now offered in 37064 by the seller on behalf of their father with the window sticker, the owner's manual, a clean Carfax report, and a Tennessee title in the owner's name.

results.title: The Wild Coast Ruling Is Bigger Than Shell: South Africa's Choice Between Oil and Its Ocean
results.description: South Africa's Constitutional Court has drawn a line in the water. On 14 August, the country's highest court set aside the exploration rights held by Shell and its local partner Impact Africa, blocking their plans to explore for oil and gas along the Wild Coast. The decision ends a five-year legal battle that placed energy development on one side and coastal communities, environmental groups and traditional livelihoods on the other.
